source.post_text:
I hate running around in circles trying to get wet in the shower.
There is no way I could travel often with these crappy hotel showers.
I even unscrewed the shower head  to remove the restrictor valve but there wasn't one.
Are there hotels that don't do this?

replies.text: You’re in a hotel what do you expect?
replies.author: @Bocephus1127

replies.text: living out of motels most of my adult life working on the road, first thing i always do is change out the shower head. kept one in my shave kit with roll of Teflon tape.
replies.author: @Deplorable_Dave

replies.text: I've noticed higher-end places and some overseas hotels skip the low-flow setups entirely so the pressure feels normal, though it really depends on local rules and the specific property.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: We stayed at this fabulous hotel in Calcutta. The water pressure in the shower was stellar. Better than at home.
replies.author: @centerepublican

decoy_rationale: The reply feels slightly too polished and explanatory with oddly balanced hedging about variables.
